Definition: from G3173 and G4241; befitting greatness or magnificence (majestic):--excellent.
BiblicalUsage: The word means excellent, befitting majesty, and Peter uses it once, of the voice from heaven: there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the excellent glory is the Father's own voice naming the Son: no greater honour exists than to be called beloved by God, and the mountain heard it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
